title: Immigration Consultant Saudi Arabia | Digital File Prep — SK Immigration
h1: Digital immigration services in Saudi Arabia
description: SK Immigration serves clients in Saudi Arabia digitally — study and visit files, attestation, and sponsor-driven visa processing only. Meet by appointment. We do not sell jobs. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you have an office in Saudi Arabia?
faqs.answer: Yes. Work is digital-first. We also meet by appointment in Saudi Arabia (Riyadh as the public city label). WhatsApp +92 304 5999859 for the current meeting point. We do not sell jobs.

faqs.question: Can you get me a Saudi job or an E-Number without a sponsor?
faqs.answer: No. We do not offer, arrange or sell jobs in Saudi Arabia. We only assist with Saudi visa processing when a legitimate sponsor in Saudi Arabia has already initiated the process.

faqs.question: I already live in KSA — can you help with a Europe study visa?
faqs.answer: Yes, when the destination rules fit your passport, academics and funds. Residence in Saudi Arabia is a fact we document honestly. German, UK and other missions decide the visa.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee a Saudi or Schengen visa?
faqs.answer: No. The Saudi authorities, embassies and universities decide. Our fee is for documentation and guidance only.

faqs.question: How do I start from Riyadh, Jeddah or Dammam?
faqs.answer: Same digital desk. Send your goal and passport biodata on WhatsApp. If you want to sit with someone, ask for an appointment. Most files never need that meeting.

body:
SK Immigration is a digital immigration desk with an appointment presence in Saudi Arabia. Clients in Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam use the same written-scope process as Pakistan. We do not sell jobs.

Sponsor-driven Saudi work cases only. We assist with Saudi visa processing only when a legitimate sponsor in Saudi Arabia has already initiated the process.

We do not offer, arrange or sell jobs in Saudi Arabia.

Who this page is for

Residents and families in the Kingdom searching for an immigration consultant in Saudi Arabia who will tell the truth about sponsors, study files and attestation. You may already have a Saudi employer process running — or you may be planning study/visit elsewhere while living in KSA.

Digital first — office when you need a meeting

Iqama life is busy. Most clients share PDFs on WhatsApp, get a gap list, and never visit a room. If you want originals checked in person, we book a Saudi appointment. The file quality standard does not change with the city.

Services we will discuss from Saudi Arabia

  • Sponsor-driven Saudi visa processing support (Enjaz / related steps only when the sponsor already exists)
  • Study-visa file preparation for Germany, UK, Canada and other destinations you actually qualify for
  • Visit files with real purpose and funds
  • Attestation / legalization sequencing when the receiving authority requires it

Red lines

  • No job offers, no “free E-Number”, no visit-to-work tricks
  • No claim that we control Jawazat, the embassy or a university
  • No fake guarantees in Arabic or English ads

How to start

  1. WhatsApp or assessment form — state city (Riyadh / Jeddah / other) and goal
  2. Written scope: our fee vs government fees
  3. Document pack online
  4. Optional appointment in Saudi Arabia
  5. You submit on official channels. Authorities decide.
